title: Flying With the Hurricane Hunters: Part 2
gist: Podcast episode notes for part two of a conversation with two veterans of the Air Force's 53rd Weather Reconnaissance Squadron about flying into storms and crew trust. No investment-relevant content in the text.

insights.claim: The episode walks through what happens on the flight deck and at the weather station as a Hurricane Hunters crew approaches a storm's eye, and the trust that holds a crew together.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Operational context on US hurricane reconnaissance; minimal market relevance.
